# vvm_template_import (Resource)

Manages a VVM template import (`/v1/templates/imports`). A template import converts a source disk image (OVA, VMDK, VHDX, qcow2) from IBM Cloud Object Storage into a VVM template or one-shot VM. All input fields are immutable: any change triggers a ForceNew (destroy + recreate). Create blocks until the import reaches a terminal state (REGISTERED or FAILED).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) UUID of the VVM cluster that will process the import.
- `datastore_id` (String) UUID of the VVM datastore where the converted disk will be stored.
- `name` (String) Name for the resulting template or VM. Part of the idempotency key: changing `name` triggers a ForceNew.
- `source_url` (String) IBM Cloud Object Storage object key of the source image (e.g. `imports/ubuntu-22.04.ova`). The object must be readable by the VVM control plane.

### Optional

- `idempotency_key` (String) Idempotency key sent in the `Idempotency-Key` header. When not provided the control plane derives one from `sha256(source_sha256 + name + cluster_id)`. The server-acknowledged key is stored in state; a second `terraform apply` with the same inputs finds the existing import via this key and returns immediately.
- `network_id` (String) UUID of the VVM network. Required when `target_kind = "vm"`; ignored for `template`.
- `project_id` (String) UUID of the VVM project the template or VM will belong to.
- `source_format_hint` (String) Format hint for the source image: `ova`, `ovf`, `vmdk`, `vhdx`, `qcow2`, or `raw`. When omitted the control plane probes the format.
- `source_sha256` (String) Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the source image. Used as part of the derived idempotency key so a second `terraform apply` with the same inputs is a no-op.
- `target_kind` (String) Target kind: `template` (default) registers a reusable template; `vm` provisions a one-shot VM immediately via Materialize.

### Read-Only

- `guest_tooling_readiness` (String) Guest tooling readiness of the resulting template: one of `paravirt-ready`, `paravirt-partial`, `unconverted`, or `unknown`.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the template import job (UUID).
- `status` (String) Final state of the import: one of `REGISTERED`, `FAILED`, or `CANCELLED`.
- `template_id` (String) UUID of the registered template. Populated when `status = REGISTERED` and `target_kind = template`.
- `vm_id` (String) UUID of the provisioned VM. Populated when `status = REGISTERED` and `target_kind = vm`.
